summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Firewall Console application. Backend API testing: 100% pass rate (36/36 tests). Frontend UI testing: All critical flows verified including authentication, navigation, RBAC, and all module pages. Minor backend bug fixed (ObjectId serialization in user creation). Application is fully functional in simulation/demo mode with live metrics, bilingual support, and proper RBAC enforcement.

fixed_bugs.issue: POST /api/users/ returned 500 error due to MongoDB ObjectId not being JSON serializable
fixed_bugs.fix: Added doc.pop('_id', None) before returning user object
